pages.text: You can edit the crop-season config in-game without touching files.$(br2)Hold the $(item)seed or crop$() you want to change in your main hand and run:$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons add spring summer$() - adds those seasons to the held item$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons remove$() - removes the held item's entry$(br2)Running $(thing)add$() repeatedly $(bold)accumulates$() seasons for the same crop.

pages.title: Growth days commands
pages.text: You can also set how many MC days a crop takes to mature:$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons growth 3$() - the held crop matures in 3 days$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons growth remove$() - revert to the automatic value$(br2)These commands write straight into $(thing)config/seedseasons-common.toml$() and take effect live.
